title: Enforce pull-request work-package scope
purpose: Require every pull request targeting main to name one canonical work package and prove that its changed files stay inside the declared allowed and forbidden boundaries.
invariants: The gate runs with read-only repository permissions and no persisted checkout credential.
Every pull request body names exactly one canonical work package.
Every changed path, including rename origins, is checked against allowedPaths and forbiddenPaths.
Global allowed patterns, binaries, archives, symbolic links, submodules, generated artifacts and transport envelopes are rejected.
Player runtime work cannot be mixed with workflow, governance, architecture, contract or platform domains.
The validator does not merge, modify, label or otherwise mutate a pull request.
requiredEvidence: PR scope workflow pass on its own implementation pull request
negative tests for missing or multiple work-package identifiers
negative tests for paths outside allowedPaths
negative tests for binary, archive, symlink and generated paths
documented ruleset configuration still required outside repository source
adversarialTests: remove the work-package id from a pull request body
name two work packages in one pull request body
rename a forbidden file into an allowed directory
introduce an archive or binary file
leave an .agent-jobs envelope in a final agent pull request
mix player runtime and workflow changes
nonGoals: configure GitHub repository rulesets through an unavailable administrative API
activate backend, synchronization, identity or commerce work
independentReview: negative smoke pull requests before acceptance
rollback: Revert the workflow, validator, documentation and this work package. Existing player source and promotion state remain unchanged.
